01_institutional_fire_history: Two institutional plans are shown separately. Values for 2017 and 2018 disagree; the forestry management area is not the Alanya district. These are source records, not calibrated model output.
02_fire_counts_by_forestry_unit: Totals from Table 14 of the 2026-2030 plan. Inter-plan discrepancies are unresolved. Forestry units are not neighbourhoods and cannot be transferred directly to district subdivisions.
03_local_resources_map: Selected resources over the geoBoundaries/OSM district boundary. PDF coordinates do not specify a datum; positions need checking before operational use. This map is not a viewshed or road travel-time analysis.
04_agricultural_production_values: District Agriculture and Forestry Directorate workbook, crop sheet, 2025. These are annual gross production values, not wildfire damage, restoration cost, or asset replacement value. English display labels are translations; source crop names and spreadsheet row numbers are retained in the inventory.
09_worldcover_map: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 classes, nearest-neighbour reprojected to 20 m for analysis. Tree cover includes cultivated trees and does not equal the OGM legal forest category. Source year differs from the 2025 agricultural inventory.
10_wildland_built_up_proximity: Configurable distance-based screening using 2021 land cover. Distances are measured between analysis pixel centres. This is not a fire-spread model, evacuation zone, building inventory, or the official EFFIS WUI product.
11_interface_buffer_sensitivity: Built-up and cropland area near tree, shrub and grass classes under 100, 300 and 500 m analyst-selected buffers. Cropland excludes tree-covered orchards not labelled as cropland by WorldCover.
14_effis_wui_indicator: Original EFFIS indicator grid | no local rescaling or disaggregation
09_ml_rasterized_historical_fires: NASA MCD64A1.061, 2001–2024 | native MODIS cells (~500 m). Grey: insufficient observations. Satellite detections omit some small fires; OIM totals have a different boundary.
10_ml_fire_observation_coverage: Fraction of 288 expected months with conservative MODIS QA support. QA excludes shortened mapping and special-condition background labels. Missing catalogue months remain in denominator.
11_ml_terrain_elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM aggregated to the native MODIS model grid. GLO-30 is a surface model. Terrain features are computed at the analysis scale; map grid ≈500 m.
12_ml_fuel_type: CORINE 2000 → CLIMAAX plant functional type groups. Original CLIMAAX CLC-to-fuel table. Static 2000 land cover retained in future maps; no local fire intensity calibration.
13_ml_susceptibility_historical: Historical climate 1991–2010 | fire labels 2001–2010 | CORINE 2000. 11 positive training cells. Later-period discrimination failed (AUC 0.19). Scores are not fire probabilities.
14_ml_hazard_historical: Historical 1991–2010. Later-period validation failed (AUC 0.19); method example only. CLIMAAX 3×4 fuel matrix with fixed historical median/75th-percentile thresholds.
ml_susceptibility_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_2021: RCP45 · 2021–2040 · CLMcom_CCLM. Later-period AUC 0.19; validation failed. 70% exceed ≥1 historical climate range. Static land cover; one RCM.
ml_hazard_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_202140: RCP45 · 2021–2040 · CLMcom_CCLM. Later-period validation failed (AUC 0.19); method example only. CLIMAAX 3×4 fuel matrix with fixed historical median/75th-percentile thresholds.
ml_change_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_202140: RCP45 · 2021–2040 · CLMcom_CCLM minus historical 1991–2010. Later-period AUC 0.19; validation failed. Relative score difference; fixed land cover and one RCM. Climate novelty is tabulated separately.
ml_susceptibility_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_2041: RCP45 · 2041–2060 · CLMcom_CCLM. Later-period AUC 0.19; validation failed. 83% exceed ≥1 historical climate range. Static land cover; one RCM.
ml_hazard_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_204160: RCP45 · 2041–2060 · CLMcom_CCLM. Later-period validation failed (AUC 0.19); method example only. CLIMAAX 3×4 fuel matrix with fixed historical median/75th-percentile thresholds.
ml_change_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_204160: RCP45 · 2041–2060 · CLMcom_CCLM minus historical 1991–2010. Later-period AUC 0.19; validation failed. Relative score difference; fixed land cover and one RCM. Climate novelty is tabulated separately.

15_ml_feature_importance: Random Forest impurity importance; not a causal effect or independent variable contribution.
00_ml_map_overview: Actual Alanya input and model outputs. Temporal model validation failed (AUC 0.19); susceptibility and hazard are method examples, not validated planning maps.
17_gis_infrastructure_overview: Supplied GIS infrastructure after datum transformation and strict district clipping. Missing-CRS layers are omitted, and source completeness/current operating status are unverified.
16_gis_boundary_comparison: The two district polygons have material differences. Existing analysis support is retained and both boundaries are available in the atlas.
18_gis_observed_fire_overlap: Actual supplied infrastructure against the union of MODIS detected burned cells, without using the failed local susceptibility model.
19_gis_fuel_proximity: WorldCover 2021 tree/shrub/grass proximity at analyst-selected distances. Tree cover may include orchards. Source infrastructure dates and completeness are unverified.
20_ml_population_economic_ecological_ris: Actual JRC vulnerability crossed with exploratory ML hazard. Zero vulnerability is valid, non-burnable and unknown are separate. The local model fails temporal transfer, so these are method examples.
21_ml_aggregated_risk_analysis_zones: Area-weighted dominant risk classes on a clearly labelled 5 km analysis grid. These are not mahalle boundaries and inherit the failed local susceptibility diagnostic.
gis_hazard_elektrik: Exact partition of supplied line geometry by exploratory hazard classes. Current local susceptibility model fails temporal validation.
gis_hazard_fiberhat: Exact partition of supplied line geometry by exploratory hazard classes. Current local susceptibility model fails temporal validation.
gis_hazard_TR_MJ_road_WGS84: Exact partition of supplied line geometry by exploratory hazard classes. Current local susceptibility model fails temporal validation.
30_response_historical_annual_exceedance: 1981–2010 | annual P(max daily FWI > 60) | six native weather cells
31_response_historical_diagnostics: Real CLIMAAX perturbed-FWI archive, unperturbed baseline. Annual days use a complete calendar; fire-season cutoff is half the baseline fitted 20-year annual-maximum return level. Area-mean FWI has different extremes from individual native cells.
32_response_gumbel_diagnostics: Gumbel fitted to 30 annual maxima. Return periods exceeding 30 years extrapolate the statistical tail; bootstrap uncertainty for baseline PE and T20 is in the CSV. Gumbel assumptions are not independently validated by local fire incidents.
33_response_joint_surfaces: Thirty-year FWI runs for 36 prescribed temperature/precipitation perturbations. Absolute and baseline-relative surfaces. Bilinear interpolation stays within adjacent response values; the source degree-four polynomial is separately diagnosed. These are perturbations, not independent climate projections.
34_response_cmip6_model_spread: Matched historical 1981–2010 baselines for MPI-ESM1-2-LR, MRI-ESM2-0 and IPSL-CM6A-LR (r1i1p1f1, Amon tas/pr). Calendar-weighted annual temperature and precipitation anomalies. Line=median of available models; band=model min–max, not a confidence interval. SSP5-8.5 in 2081–2100 retains only one of three models inside the response domain; no ensemble spread can be assessed there.
35_response_native_cell_projections: Coarse native FWI cells, not downscaled local fire probability. Future cell PE is interpolated for model-specific regional temperature/precipitation anomalies; source weather-cell differences are retained.
36_response_affected_population: People/cell counts conserved by fractional native population-cell intersections with district and weather cells. SSP2 pairs with SSP2-4.5, SSP5 with SSP5-8.5. Midpoint population years 2030/2050/2070/2090 pair with 20-year climate periods. Bands show the spread of available models, not uncertainty quantiles. SSP5-8.5 in 2081–2100 has only one in-domain model; missing models are not extrapolated. Counts are residents in danger-weather cells, not casualties or predicted fire impacts.
37_response_population_weather_cells: Population counts aggregated without downscaling weather | six native FWI cells
38_response_infrastructure_weather: All accepted electricity, fibre, road lines and four energy facilities assigned to native FWI cells; exact line lengths conserved. Historical and 24 model/scenario/future combinations exported. Missing fragility and functional network data prevent outage/loss estimation.
39_response_relative_danger: Baseline JJAS FWI from the public response archive | local relative index
40_response_pareto_profiles: All four assessed native-cell profiles are non-dominated, covering about 66.1% of district area; this does not identify a unique spatial ranking. Executed adaptation of the FWI/fuel/Pareto branch, separate from the still-undownloaded authenticated EWDS/CDS product. All objectives maximise exposure/indicator level; no intervention optimisation, calibrated probability or loss is implied. Missing PAF/irreplaceability explicitly excluded.
change_predictors_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_2021: Fourteen real ECLIPS predictor differences. Future minus fixed 1991–2010 reference. Absolute physical units avoid misleading Celsius percentage changes. This is one RCM, not an ensemble.
change_predictors_RCP45_CLMcom_CCLM_2041: Fourteen real ECLIPS predictor differences. Future minus fixed 1991–2010 reference. Absolute physical units avoid misleading Celsius percentage changes. This is one RCM, not an ensemble.

22_ml_hazard_and_risk_change: Direction of ordinal class change, not subtraction of physical risk or a percent loss change. Only comparable valid historical/future classes are included. Failed ML temporal discrimination and static vulnerability constrain interpretation.
23_road_vulnerability_interval: Original CLIMAAX road classes: primary=1, secondary=2, tertiary=3. The supplied source combines primary/secondary, so a lower–upper class envelope is retained; tertiary/local streets are not supplied as a complete inventory.
24_road_risk_historical_future_interval: Original risk matrix applied separately to both defensible road vulnerability classes. Historical and future hazard use fixed susceptibility quantiles. Unknown/non-burnable cells remain separate; all maps inherit failed local ML validation.
43_response_rolling_climate_diagnostics: Every model uses its own 1981–2010 reference. Monthly temperature is calendar-day weighted and precipitation flux is integrated using each model calendar. Lines use overlapping 20-year windows and are not independent samples. Missing late-century PE is outside the response domain, not zero.
44_response_population_counterfactual: The same 2041–2060 model weather responses are crossed with each SSP source’s fixed 2020 count map and its 2050 map. Difference reflects scenario population redistribution/growth, not weather change alone. Bands are model min–max, not confidence intervals.
